releaseTitle: ATalk v3.2.1 — Chat Reliability, Instant Send & Realtime Sync Fixes
releaseNotes:
• Fixed contact conversation resolution bug: Messages now send reliably without foreign key errors when opened from Contacts
• Fixed Realtime WebSocket token authentication: Supabase CDC events now stream instantly with authenticated RLS permissions
• Sub-2s fallback sync: Incoming messages appear within 2 seconds even under aggressive cellular carrier packet drops
• On-demand peer sync: Sending a message immediately refreshes conversation state for seamless bidirectional chat
